verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm with a documented IP practice, so trade-secret work is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence covers only patents, brands and trade marks, and general IP framing. Nothing in the pack mentions trade-secret protection, confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes or trade-secret litigation. The employment-tribunal and cyber pages are adjacent areas and earn no credit.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm documents trade-secret protection work — confidentiality programs, employee-mobility disputes, or trade-secret litigation
